name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures and initials with customizable tools, timestamps, save templates, verification, mobile optimization, and sign documents. Features include drawing with color/thickness controls, image upload, webcam capture, undo/redo, eraser mode, date/time overlay, initials mode, saved signature templates, document signing with PDF overlay, signature verification with SHA-256 hash and audit trail, and enhanced mobile experience with gestures, fullscreen mode, and stylus support.

Version 3.7.0 New Features:

  • Mobile Optimization: Enhanced experience for smartphones and tablets
  • Touch Gestures: Swipe to clear, double-tap to undo, pinch to zoom
  • Fullscreen Mode: Full-screen signing for better experience
  • Stylus Support: Apple Pencil and S-Pen with pressure sensitivity
  • Orientation Detection: Prompt to rotate device for better signing
  • Haptic Feedback: Vibration feedback for touch interactions

Version 3.6.0 Features:

  • Signature Verification: SHA-256 hash and tamper detection

Version 3.5.0 Features:

  • Initials Mode: Compact component for capturing initials/rubrics

Version 3.4.0 Features:

  • Timestamp Overlay: Date/time with audit info

Version 3.3.0 Features:

  • Customization Toolbar: Color, thickness, eraser, undo/redo

Version 3.2.0 Features:

  • Signature Templates: Save and reuse signatures

Version 3.1.0 Features:

  • Document Signing: PDF/image with signature overlay

Version 3.0.0 Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, Webcam
